name: google-news
label: Google News
title: Google News Scraper
summary: Search Google News for coverage of brands, companies and industry topics.
use: Monitor brand mentions, follow industry coverage and compare publishers.
limits: Returns news metadata and available snippets, not article full text. Dates may be relative or absent.
description: Scrape Google News by keyword and get headlines, publishers, dates, links and available snippets. Filter by country, language and time range. Requires a FlashData API key and Credits; Apify usage is billed separately.
inputDescription: Search Google News for coverage of brands, companies and industry topics. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is billed separately. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

name: google-images
label: Google Images
title: Google Images Scraper
summary: Find image references and source pages for visual research.
use: Collect visual references, find source pages and research image search results.
limits: Returns image references, not image files or reuse licenses. Image URLs can expire or require access.
description: Scrape Google Images by keyword and get image URLs, source pages, titles and available dimensions. Export results as JSON or CSV. Requires a FlashData API key and Credits; Apify usage is billed separately.
inputDescription: Find image references and source pages for visual research. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is billed separately. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

name: google-shopping
label: Google Shopping
title: Google Shopping Scraper
summary: Search Google Shopping by keyword and collect product listings in a structured dataset. Compare the offers returned for a product category, review merchant coverage and research displayed prices in different markets.
use: Use it to explore a product niche, shortlist competing offers or collect a pricing snapshot for further analysis.
limits: Prices are text snapshots, not final checkout totals or a price-history service. Fields may be absent; stock and equivalent product specifications are not guaranteed.
description: Scrape Google Shopping results with product titles, merchants, prices, links and available ratings. Customize country, language and search location. Requires a FlashData API key and Credits; Apify usage is billed separately.
inputDescription: Find product listings, displayed prices and merchant links on Google Shopping. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is separate. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

name: google-videos
label: Google Videos
title: Google Videos Scraper
summary: Search Google's video results and collect links from across the web in one dataset. Find tutorials, product demonstrations and topical coverage, with source and video details that help you choose what to watch or investigate next.
use: Use it for video content research, competitor discovery or finding explanations across different publishing sites.
limits: Returns Google video-search metadata, not video files or transcripts. Source, duration, channel and date fields depend on the response.
description: Scrape Google Videos results with titles, links and available durations, channels, sources and dates. Customize country, language and search location. Requires a FlashData API key and Credits; Apify usage is billed separately.
inputDescription: Find video results across websites through Google Videos. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is separate. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

name: google-places
label: Google Places
title: Google Places Scraper
summary: Find local businesses and places by keyword and location. Collect a structured shortlist of cafes, shops, service providers or other places, with the contact and business details available in Google's search response.
use: Use it for local market research, supplier discovery or planning a list of places to review.
limits: Search results are snapshots, not full-city coverage. Contact details, ratings and coordinates may be absent. Does not crawl business websites or retrieve review text.
description: Find local businesses on Google and extract names, addresses, categories and available ratings, phone numbers and websites. Export JSON or CSV. Requires a FlashData API key and Credits; Apify usage is billed separately.
inputDescription: Find local businesses, addresses and available contact details on Google. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is separate. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

name: youtube-search
label: YouTube Search
title: YouTube Search Scraper
summary: Turn a YouTube keyword search into a compact dataset of video results. Find relevant tutorials, product reviews and topic coverage, with filters that help narrow the search before you inspect individual videos.
use: Use it to shortlist videos for content research, compare coverage of a topic or collect video IDs for a separate metadata or caption lookup.
limits: One query requests 1–20 results, default20; actual count and fields may vary. Does not download videos, retrieve captions or enrich each result with a separate detail request.
description: Search YouTube by keyword and extract titles, video IDs and available channel, duration, view and date metadata. Apply search filters; request up to 20 results. Requires a FlashData API key and Credits; Apify usage is billed separately.
inputDescription: Search YouTube by keyword with filters and up to 20 requested results. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is separate. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

name: youtube-search-extended
label: YouTube Extended Search
title: YouTube Search Scraper – Extended
summary: Build a larger collection of YouTube search results for a topic. Extended Search lets you request up to 700 items from one query, giving content researchers and analysts more candidates to review than the standard 20-result search.
use: Use it to explore broad topics, assemble a video research dataset or compare a larger set of content before selecting individual videos.
limits: Single query; max_results1–700, default20, results not guaranteed. Higher extended-search rate; no multi-query mode, automatic pagination or detail enrichment.
description: Search YouTube by keyword and request up to 700 results with available titles, channels, durations, views and dates. Uses the extended-search rate. Requires a FlashData API key and Credits; Apify usage is billed separately.
inputDescription: Search YouTube with up to 700 requested results at the extended-search FlashData rate. Apify usage is separate. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

name: youtube-metadata
label: YouTube Metadata
title: YouTube Video Metadata Scraper
summary: Look up a YouTube video and collect its details in structured JSON. Review the title, channel, duration and viewing statistics, with options to include available chapters and media format information.
use: Use it to inspect a video before further processing, organize a video catalog or locate sections using available chapter timestamps.
limits: Single video ID. Metadata fields depend on availability. Chapters and format metadata are optional; this Actor does not download media or retrieve captions.
description: Extract YouTube video details from a video ID: title, channel, duration, views and available chapters and format metadata. Export structured JSON. Requires a FlashData API key and Credits; Apify usage is billed separately.
inputDescription: Get YouTube video details, available chapters and format metadata from one video ID. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is separate. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

name: youtube-transcript
label: YouTube Transcript
title: YouTube Transcripts for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Get existing YouTube automatic captions for AI research and summarization workflows. Export timestamped segments and retain full transcript text in JSON.
use: Supply time-aligned source text to a research or summarization agent, which can inspect the text and associate claims with video timestamps.
limits: Reads existing captions only. Defaults to automatic captions (auto=true) in English. No speech recognition, translation, or automatic fallback to uploader captions. Availability is not guaranteed; automatic captions can contain errors.

name: youtube-captions
label: YouTube Uploader Captions
title: YouTube Uploader Captions for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Read existing uploader-provided YouTube captions for AI agents. Export timestamped segments in a selected language and retain full caption text as JSON.
use: Retrieve an available uploader caption track for an agent's quotation, video research, or multilingual-source review workflow.
limits: Defaults to uploader-provided captions (auto=false) in English. Does not generate captions, translate, or fall back to automatic captions. A missing track is a valid availability limitation, not a reason to repeat the request automatically.

name: youtube-trainability
label: YouTube License Metadata
title: YouTube License Metadata for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Inspect a YouTube video's Creative Commons license label for AI research workflows. Returns the license classification in JSON; it does not grant training or reuse permission.
use: Let an agent record the available license-label classification as one piece of metadata during a source review.
limits: The API source is named youtube_trainability, but it checks license metadata, not the creator's third-party AI-training setting. permitted=["all"] means the Creative Commons label was detected; ["none"] includes absent license metadata. Neither result grants permission or replaces a rights assessment.

name: youtube-channel
label: YouTube Channel
title: YouTube Channels for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Inspect YouTube channels and recent videos for AI research agents. Use a channel handle to retrieve profile data and a recent-video sample of up to 100 items.
use: Build a channel profile, inspect recent publishing topics, and pass selected video IDs into metadata or caption workflows.
limits: Use a handle, with or without @; do not use a full URL or channel ID. video_limit is 1–100 (default 20); this is a recent-video sample, not the complete channel history. Profile counts may be absent and are not converted to zero.

name: youtube-suggestions
label: YouTube Autocomplete
title: YouTube Autocomplete for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Discover YouTube autocomplete phrases for AI topic-research agents. Submit a query prefix with language and region and export one suggestion per dataset row.
use: Explore query wording and candidate subtopics before an agent chooses which YouTube searches to perform.
limits: Suggestions are phrases, not video results, search-volume estimates, or popularity rankings. Empty suggestions are valid. Each language/region request is separate; the Actor does not expand queries automatically.

name: youtube-download
label: YouTube to Cloud Storage
title: YouTube to Cloud Storage for AI Agents — FlashData
summary: Deliver YouTube video or audio to your cloud storage for AI workflows. Submit one download job, read progress and export its delivery manifest. Uses your FlashData Key and Credits; Apify usage is separate.
use: Deliver media into a storage location you control for an authorized downstream processing workflow. The agent can inspect the job status and delivery manifest.
limits: Async only. Requires your own supported storage and credentials; does not provide a shared public download bucket. Private files remain subject to your storage access controls. You are responsible for permission to obtain and use the media. No speech recognition or translation is included.
